nox.desc_zh: 全身焦黑树皮质感的类人形体，被幽绿色火焰环绕，细长的绿色发光双眼，胸口有一个冒着绿色余烬旋涡的黑暗空洞，手指细长如利爪，轮廓不断剥离黑烟与火星
nox.desc_en: charred obsidian-bark humanoid wreathed in ghostly green flame, narrow glowing green eyes, hollow smoldering void in the chest with a faint green ember swirl, long claw-like fingers, dark smoke and embers peeling off its outline
signature_marks: hollow chest void w/ green ember swirl

voice.mint_text: A very deep, gravelly male voice with a faint metallic echo, slow and calm with quiet menace, says: <line>
voice.usage: pass as reference_audios[] on seedance-2.0/reference-to-video (owner-verified: voice holds across separate gens); keep any future mint <=15s or Seedance 400s with DurationTooLong
voice.delivery: MOUTHLESS pulse-speech (owner-approved): no mouth ever — green eyes flare and the hollow chest void pulses/swirls in rhythm with the voice, smoke agitates with tone. Native gens (no audio ref) invent a mouth — always pin with voice ref + mouthless prompt language.
voice.persona: theatrical calm menace with dry amusement; smug, unhurried, finds the heroes entertaining

rime.desc_zh: 由暗色风暴寒冰构成的细长幽灵般男性人形，冰壳深处流动着淡蓝白色极光纹路，光滑无面目的冰质头部上有两道细长的冰蓝色发光眼缝，胸口嵌着一枚从冰层深处发出冷蓝白光的六角霜星晶核，肩后拖着如落雪碎雾般的破碎冰披风，指尖是细长优雅的晶体利爪，周身缓缓环绕漂浮的雪晶与寒雾
rime.desc_en: slender wraith-like male humanoid of dark storm-ice veined with slow-moving pale aurora light, smooth featureless ice head with two narrow glowing ice-blue eye-slits, jagged six-pointed frost-star core glowing cold blue-white deep in his chest, long tattered mantle of frozen mist trailing like falling snow, elongated elegant crystalline claws, snow crystals and cold vapor drifting around him
signature_marks: ice-blue eye-slits on featureless ice face
aurora veins under dark storm-ice plates

ALT: voice_rime_imgref.mp3 = experimental image-ref mint (voice styled from sheet portrait via references:[{image_data}]) — worked first try, good levels; candidate zero-touch path for per-episode villain automation
voice.delivery: MOUTHLESS pulse-speech (Nox convention carried over): featureless ice face — eye-slits flare and the chest frost-star pulses cold light in rhythm with the voice; frost-mist breath curls with each phrase
voice.persona: glacial patience, elegant contempt; speaks slowly and softly, certain of the outcome; winter-is-inevitable fatalism
